metadata.name: atq
metadata.description: List pending jobs in the at queue

installation.note: atq is part of the at package

overview.summary: atq lists pending jobs in the at queue. Each job has a number used with atrm to remove it. Without options, atq shows the current user's jobs; root can see all with -a or by default on some systems.
when_to_use: See what at jobs are scheduled
Get job numbers to cancel with atrm

syntax.description: atq reads the at queue and prints job number, date/time, queue, and user.

options.description: Show only jobs in specified queue (a-z, A-Z)

examples.title: List pending jobs
examples.description: Show your pending at jobs with job numbers and run times

related_commands.description: Remove a job (use job number from atq)
